name: beyond_get_result_page
description: Return the next page of an automatically paged MCP tool result. Use paging.result_id and paging.next_cursor from the prior response. Large responses use paged delivery even when the operation partially or fully failed. In a paged response outer success is page-delivery status only; inspect data.operation_status.success/is_error, failed_count and bounded failed_preview immediately. Retrieve and assemble ALL page_content fragments to obtain complete created objects, ID mappings and failed entries. Retry only failed items, never the entire partially successful batch.

result_id.description: Paged result identifier returned in paging.result_id.

cursor.description: Next page cursor returned in paging.next_cursor. Numeric page indexes are also accepted.

include_json_content.description: When false, omit duplicated JSON from text content and rely on structuredContent.

output_contract_note: No outputSchema is declared by the inspected public source definition. Consult live help and actual results; do not infer a missing output contract.
